args.title: Fix overlapping statements issue in dedupe.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The current implementation of the dedupe function does not handle cases where two statements with overlapping days are uploaded together. This results in duplicate entries. Modify the dedupe function to properly detect duplicates by including logic to handle overlapping date ranges.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The dedupe function does not correctly handle overlapping statements when two files with overlapping days are uploaded together. The function needs to be adjusted to account for and detect these duplicates properly.
